title: PAH-OMC-020 restricted radial semigroup consistency
question: For bounded amplitude-only local cylinders, does the unchanged finite stationary PAH semigroup converge uniformly on compact external Markov-time intervals to the identity action of the R-512 minimal-form semigroup in the registered j-before-anchored-n order?
finding: Yes on the restricted amplitude-only subspace. PH/LK/AP roots leave matter amplitudes unchanged, TR roots move the amplitude l1 coordinate by at most 2 h_j, and R-511 gives ||L_TR S_nj f||_2 <= 2 H_f L_f h_j. Stationary L2 contraction gives a uniform compact-time error <= 2 T H_f L_f h_j. This does not address non-radial anchored-n transfer.
